notes: Standard VAT 18% (PwC Georgia); PwC lists no investment-gold exemption, so retail bullion and jewellery pay 18%. NBG gold-bar certificates, 27 Nov 2026: 20 g buy GEL 5,785.32 / sell 6,262.46; 1,000 g buy 289,265.80 / sell 313,122.77 - a 7.6% buyback discount at both sizes. No spot price read on a primary page, so premiums empty; gold import duty not stated (general rates 0/5/12%), so null.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Georgia, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: Standard VAT rate is 18% and applies to the supply of all goods and services; VAT-exempt supplies listed (financial services, oil and gas goods, certain medical and education services) include no investment-gold exemption. Import tax general rates are 0%, 5% and 12% with no gold-specific rate stated.

sources.name: National Bank of Georgia - Gold Bars Certificates
sources.what: NBG certificate prices updated 27 Nov 2026 for 999.9 gold bars: 20 g purchase GEL 5,785.32 / sales GEL 6,262.46; 1,000 g purchase GEL 289,265.80 / sales GEL 313,122.77. Buyback discount = (sales - purchase) / sales = 7.6% at both sizes.
